listing.name: Blue Reaper
listing.summary: Paints the Reaper torpedo blue. No other effect. Now also turns the Cobra bomber's engines blue.
listing.aiSummary: Changes the color of Reaper torpedoes and Cobra bomber engines to blue.

description:
Blue Reapers!

Have you ever wanted to use Reapers on your high-tech ships, but didn't like the color?  This mod is for you.

Paints the Reaper torpedo blue.  No other effect. Now also turns the Cobra bomber's engines blue.
Safe to add or remove from a game in progress
Download Here.

discordPostHtml:
That's it, that's the mod. Paints the Reaper torpedo blue.

Save compatible, can be added OR removed safely from an active save.
Forum link: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=30687.0
aiDescription: Recolors Reaper torpedoes from their default appearance to blue. It also changes the engine glow of Cobra bombers to match this blue theme. The mod has no other gameplay effects.
